test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, which of the following statement is correct?

options.text: Mother gave only the cab fare and did not took the umbrella in return.
Old man was selling them a silk umberlla worth one pounds.
When mother and girl decided to go home they had no umbrella.
The old man used the pound note given by the girl's mother to take the taxi home.

solution:
The correct answer is "When mother and girl decided to go home they had no umbrella."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• We are required to select the correct statement among the given options.
 
• Now, let us consider the following:
 
 
• Line 6: The mother offers to simply give him the cab fare, but he insists that they take the umbrella. The transaction is made and everyone is happy. 
 
 
• It implies that option 1 is incorrect. The transaction of selling the umbrella did happen.
 
 
 
• Line 3 and 4: He explains that it’s a very nice silk umbrella worth twenty pounds.
 
 
• ​Thus, option 2 is also incorrect.
 
 
 
• Line 2: When it’s time to go home, they discover that it’s pouring rain and they have no umbrella.
 
 
• ​Thus, option 3 is correct with respect to the given passage.
 
 
 
• In the passage, it is mentioned that the old man used the money to go the pub and ordered a drink for himself.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct statement with respect to the given passage is option 3.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
